issue.title: Write sase glossary add/del into the invoking checkout's sase.yml
issue.description: Discovered while implementing glossary workspace-project inference. Inference now resolves a numbered workspace to the correct project, but resolve_project_config_read_path / resolve_project_config_write_path still use record.workspace_dir (the ProjectSpec primary checkout). That is byte-for-byte what sase glossary add -p sase already did from a workspace, so it is not a regression of the inference fix — but it means an agent that adds a term from sase_14 still writes ~/projects/github/sase-org/sase/sase/sase.yml instead of the workspace tree they will commit. Recommended by the approved plan as a follow-up feature, not bundled into the inference change.

task_type_fields.proposal: After sase glossary infers the project from a numbered workspace, add/del still read and write the project's primary checkout sase/sase.yml (record.workspace_dir), not the invoking workspace's own copy. Make the invoking checkout's sase/sase.yml the read/write target so an agent's glossary edits land in the tree they will commit from, matching sase flag new and sase memory init. This also needs an explicit decision about -p/--project: today -p sase from a workspace already writes the primary checkout.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved glossary workspace-project inference plan (glossary_workspace_project_inference.md) deliberately keeps inference as project-identity only. Changing the write target would also change -p semantics and is a separate product decision, not part of the inference fix.
